The significant turnaround in net income from a loss to profit contributes significantly to the positive score, but the other negatives keep it from being substantially higher.

**Confidence Level:**

The confidence level is 0.75. While the analysis is based on a limited dataset (one quarter each year), the trends are clearly visible.  A longer time frame would provide a more comprehensive view and increase confidence further.
